6) Any SOC2/SIG-specific artifacts you maintain for crypto controls (we'll map to CAIQ entries).

We'd prefer the artifacts via an encrypted SFTP or a secure drive link. Target: get this to our procurement team by 2/18 so contracts can move.

Hi Tim — thanks for the checklist. I'm attaching the items we can share immediately and providing terse answers below. If you need deeper artifacts we can redact or create a compliance appendix.

Attachments included: hsm-attestation-2027.pdf, rotation-log-sample.csv, kms-key-policy.md

Short answers (mapping to your bullets):
1) HSM attestation: Thales Luna SA+ v5.3.2; tamper-evident hardware; FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified. Attestation includes device serials and firmware checksums in the attached PDF.

2) Rotation logs: sample CSV shows automated KEK rotation events with timestamps and operator ticket reference. We can redact operator email addresses per your policy; full logs available under an NDA.

3) KMS key policy & separation of duties: we run a hierarchical envelope model — tenant DEK encrypted with per-tenant KEK stored on HSM. Operators with rotation privileges are SRE on-call roles, which are separate from key-import roles managed by the security team. Policy doc attached.

4) Transit/At-Rest ciphers: TLS 1.3 only for client connections (ECDHE key exchange + AES-256-GCM); internal RPC uses mTLS with AES-GCM or CHACHA20-POLY1305 depending on CPU availability. At-rest: envelope encryption with AES-256-GCM DEKs; KEKs wrapped in HSM.

5) BYOK import: supported. Workflow: customer wraps keys with RSA-OAEP-256 using our import public key, we perform a verification step inside the HSM and then seal the KEK. We provide audit logs for import events. Remote attestation at import time: we provide HSM attestation statements and a hardware-backed import receipt; we do not export private key material after import.

6) SOC2/SIG artifacts: we maintain an audit bundle that maps to SIG and CAIQ fields; can produce a control mapping and a short narrative for your assessor.

Security notes and constraints:
- We do not hold raw customer key material in plaintext outside the HSM boundary.
- Emergency rotation: documented runbook, tokenized ticketing handoff, and time-stamped rotation event captured in the rotation log.
- Retention: rotation events retained for 24 months; access logs retained per your region SLA.

If you want, we can schedule a technical call this week to demo the import process and walk through the CSV fields.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
